raw_affiliation_strings: Dan Jakubowski received his PhD from University of Florida in 2016 after conducting over three years of field research in Cairo and Alexandria. His dissertation recounted the history of video art in Egypt from the early 1990s to the present day, exploring how Egyptian artists used video to engage their nation's relationship with modernity, globalization, and late capitalism. His current work historicizes the role of the biennial and other large-scale, international exhibition formats on the development of artists and institutions in Africa and elsewhere in the non-Western world
